messages:
incident-bot: automated alert — p99 latency breached 1100ms for service inference-api (eu-west) for 6m. SLO burn: 18%. PagerDuty incident PD-9876 created.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-9876 fired -> @alice (oncall). Please acknowledge.
alice (oncall): acked, pulling up dashboards and traces.
alice (oncall): p95 is ~2x baseline, p99 has spikes. correlation with KV cache miss rate and a growing batcher backlog on gpu-pool-3.
matt-sre: noted. any deploys in last 30m?
sana-eng: yes — small canary rollout: vmix-quantized-v2 pushed ~20m ago, traffic shifted ~10% 12m ago.
dan-ops: scaling dedicated-gpu-pool (dedicated-gpu-pool) +2 nodes now, ETA ~3m.
alice (oncall): thanks. rerouting non-critical routes to fallback-model-small to reduce load on hot pools. adding temporary rate-limit for long requests.
alice (oncall): runbook step: check KV hitrate + batcher queue: https://grafana/redwood/kv-hits?range=15m and https://grafana/redwood/batcher-queue?range=15m
matt-sre: KV hitrate dropped from ~82% -> 23% coincident with canary shift. batcher queue length increased.
sana-eng: that matches. quantized variant appears to cause cache churn during warmup, evicting prefixes. recommend rollback of canary to v1.
alice (oncall): initiating rollback to vmix-quantized-v1 now: \n```\n./deploy rollback --service inference-api --to vmix-quantized-v1\n```\nincident-bot: rollback task tg-5421 started.
pagerduty: PD-9876 acknowledged by alice (oncall) at 3470012350.
matt-sre: rollback in progress, KV warms slowly — hitrate ~40% and climbing.
alice (oncall): early signal: p99 down to ~520ms, p95 improving. keeping autoscale running.
sana-eng: checking SLI logs: no error surge, just latency. customer-facing success rate steady. will prepare postmortem draft.
dan-ops: scaled nodes are up, autoscaler parameters need review — will open a followup ticket.
oncall-rotation: handing off to matt for overnight monitoring. I'll update PD notes and leave context in the incident ticket. matt you're on in ~30m.
matt-sre: taking the handoff. leaving incident open until stable for 30m rolling window.
alice (oncall): agree. will not close PD until p99 stable below alert threshold for 20m.
incident-bot: monitoring: SLO burn falling, watching 20m window for regressions.
alice (oncall): creating INC-2026 for actionable follow-ups (root cause: canary + KV warmup/eviction; mitigation: rollback + autoscale).
sana-eng: I'll add warmup steps to Optimize playbook for quantized models and propose KV resilience improvements.
pagerduty: PD-9876 resolved by alice (oncall) at 3470012600.
alice (oncall): resolving Slack thread but keeping INC-2026 open for postmortem and action items. thanks all :thumbsup:
